message: You know that moment when you're trying to check the weather and your phone decides it's the perfect time to die? I had that happen during a summer storm last year. I was squinting at the sky, hoping to decipher whether the clouds were angry or just slightly grumpy. I learned then to keep a good old-fashioned battery-powered radio around—turns out, some things never go out of style! It's nice to have a backup plan, especially when technology throws a tantrum. What’s your go-to prep tip for those stormy days? ☔
